```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(shiny)

# 正式考试不使用 learnr 的跨会话持久化。
# 每次 run_exam() 都从空白答题状态开始，避免旧代码/旧填空串入新考试。
options(
  tutorial.storage = list(
    save_object = function(
      tutorial_id,
      tutorial_version,
      user_id,
      object_id,
      data
    ) {
      invisible(NULL)
    },
    get_object = function(
      tutorial_id,
      tutorial_version,
      user_id,
      object_id
    ) {
      NULL
    },
    get_objects = function(
      tutorial_id,
      tutorial_version,
      user_id
    ) {
      list()
    },
    remove_all_objects = function(
      tutorial_id,
      tutorial_version,
      user_id
    ) {
      invisible(NULL)
    }
  )
)

paper_path <- Sys.getenv("RMEDLEARN_EXAM_PAPER", unset = "")

if (!nzchar(paper_path) || !file.exists(paper_path)) {
  stop("未找到 exam_paper.rds。请使用 RMedLearn::run_exam() 启动考试。")
}

paper <- if (tolower(tools::file_ext(paper_path)) == "json") {
  if (!requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("读取 JSON 试卷需要 jsonlite 包。")
  }
  jsonlite::fromJSON(
    paper_path,
    simplifyVector = FALSE
  )
} else {
  readRDS(paper_path)
}

# 学生端不显示内部版本说明“教师建议版”。
if (!is.null(paper$title) && length(paper$title) == 1L) {
  paper$title <- sub(
    "[[:space:]]*[（(]教师建议版[）)][[:space:]]*$",
    "",
    as.character(paper$title)
  )
}

learnr::tutorial_options(
  exercise.eval = FALSE,
  exercise.timelimit = 90,
  exercise.blanks = FALSE,
  exercise.reveal_solution = FALSE,
  exercise.startover = FALSE,
  exercise.diagnostics = TRUE
)

.exam_live_code <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())

exam_session_bucket <- function(session) {
  if (is.null(session) || is.null(session$token)) {
    stop("无法识别当前考试会话，请重新打开考试。", call. = FALSE)
  }

  key <- as.character(session$token)

  if (!exists(key, envir = .exam_live_code, inherits = FALSE)) {
    assign(
      key,
      new.env(parent = emptyenv()),
      envir = .exam_live_code
    )
  }

  get(key, envir = .exam_live_code, inherits = FALSE)
}

exam_extract_setwd_path <- function(code) {
  exprs <- tryCatch(
    parse(text = paste(code, collapse = "\n")),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(exprs)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  found <- NULL

  walk_expr <- function(x) {
    if (!is.null(found) || !is.call(x)) {
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    if (identical(x[[1]], as.name("setwd")) && length(x) >= 2L) {
      arg <- x[[2]]

      if (is.character(arg) && length(arg) == 1L) {
        found <<- arg
        return(invisible(NULL))
      }
    }

    for (part in as.list(x)[-1]) {
      walk_expr(part)
    }

    invisible(NULL)
  }

  for (expr in exprs) {
    walk_expr(expr)
  }

  found
}

exam_saved_workdir <- function() {
  session <- shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()

  if (is.null(session)) {
    caller <- parent.frame()

    if (exists("session", envir = caller, inherits = TRUE)) {
      session <- get("session", envir = caller, inherits = TRUE)
    }
  }

  bucket <- exam_session_bucket(session)

  if (!exists(".exam_workdir", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) {
    stop(
      "请先完成第1题中的“设置工作空间”代码框并点击“运行代码”。",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  get(".exam_workdir", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)
}

exam_is_absolute_path <- function(path) {
  is.character(path) &&
    length(path) == 1L &&
    grepl("^(?:[A-Za-z]:[/\\\\]|/|~[/\\\\]?)", path)
}

exam_resolve_path <- function(
  path,
  workdir = exam_saved_workdir()
) {
  if (!is.character(path) ||
      length(path) != 1L ||
      !nzchar(path)) {
    return(path)
  }

  if (exam_is_absolute_path(path)) {
    return(path.expand(path))
  }

  file.path(workdir, path)
}

exam_prepare_workdir <- function(envir = parent.frame()) {
  workdir <- exam_saved_workdir()
  target <- envir

  assign(
    "getwd",
    local({
      wd <- workdir
      function() wd
    }),
    envir = target
  )

  assign(
    "read.csv",
    local({
      wd <- workdir
      function(file, ...) {
        utils::read.csv(exam_resolve_path(file, wd), ...)
      }
    }),
    envir = target
  )

  assign(
    "read.table",
    local({
      wd <- workdir
      function(file, ...) {
        utils::read.table(exam_resolve_path(file, wd), ...)
      }
    }),
    envir = target
  )

  assign(
    "write.csv",
    local({
      wd <- workdir
      function(x, file = "", ...) {
        out <- if (is.character(file) &&
                   length(file) == 1L &&
                   nzchar(file)) {
          exam_resolve_path(file, wd)
        } else {
          file
        }

        utils::write.csv(x, file = out, ...)
      }
    }),
    envir = target
  )

  invisible(workdir)
}

exam_replay <- function(labels) {
  labels <- as.character(labels)

  session <- shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()

  if (is.null(session)) {
    caller <- parent.frame()

    if (exists("session", envir = caller, inherits = TRUE)) {
      session <- get("session", envir = caller, inherits = TRUE)
    }
  }

  bucket <- exam_session_bucket(session)

  exam_prepare_workdir(envir = parent.frame())

  for (label in labels) {
    if (!exists(label, envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) {
      stop(
        sprintf(
          "请先完成前面的代码框（%s）并点击“运行代码”。",
          label
        ),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }

    code <- paste(
      get(label, envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE),
      collapse = "\n"
    )

    if (!nzchar(trimws(code))) {
      stop(
        sprintf(
          "前面的代码框（%s）还没有可用代码。",
          label
        ),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }

    tryCatch(
      eval(parse(text = code), envir = parent.frame()),
      error = function(e) {
        stop(
          sprintf(
            "前面的代码框（%s）运行有误，请先返回修正。原错误：%s",
            label,
            conditionMessage(e)
          ),
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }
    )
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}

exam_format_rules <- function() {
  if (!is.null(paper$format_rules) && length(paper$format_rules) > 0L) {
    return(as.character(paper$format_rules))
  }

  lines <- unlist(
    strsplit(
      paper$format_full,
      "\n",
      fixed = TRUE
    )
  )

  lines <- trimws(lines)
  lines <- lines[nzchar(lines)]
  lines <- lines[!grepl("^结果填写规范", lines)]

  sub(
    "^[0-9]+[.][[:space:]]*",
    "",
    lines
  )
}

exam_format_full_ui <- function() {
  rules <- exam_format_rules()

  shiny::tags$div(
    class = "exam-format",
    shiny::tags$ol(
      class = "format-list",
      lapply(
        rules,
        shiny::tags$li
      )
    )
  )
}

exam_fill_inputs <- function(question) {
  if (length(question$fills) == 0L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  shiny::tags$div(
    class = "fill-section",
    shiny::tags$div(
      class = "answer-section-label",
      "结果填写"
    ),
    shiny::tags$div(
      class = "fill-grid",
      lapply(
        question$fills,
        function(x) {
          shiny::tags$div(
            class = "fill-item",
            shiny::textInput(
              inputId = x$id,
              label = x$label,
              value = "",
              width = "100%"
            )
          )
        }
      )
    ),
    shiny::tags$div(
      class = "format-reminder",
      sub(
        "^[[:space:]]*⚠[[:space:]]*",
        "",
        paper$format_short
      )
    )
  )
}

exam_question_steps <- function(question) {
  if (!is.null(question$steps) && length(question$steps) > 0L) {
    return(question$steps)
  }

  paragraphs <- unlist(
    strsplit(
      question$text,
      "\n\n",
      fixed = TRUE
    )
  )

  paragraphs <- trimws(paragraphs)
  paragraphs <- paragraphs[nzchar(paragraphs)]

  lapply(
    seq_along(paragraphs),
    function(i) {
      list(
        title = paste0("任务 ", i),
        text = sub(
          "^（[0-9]+）[[:space:]]*",
          "",
          paragraphs[[i]]
        )
      )
    }
  )
}

exam_question_header <- function(question) {
  cat(
    sprintf(
      "## %s\n\n",
      question$title
    )
  )

  cat(
    sprintf(
      paste0(
        '<div class="score-line">',
        '代码 %d 分 <span>·</span> ',
        '填空 %d 分 <span>·</span> ',
        '共 %d 分',
        '</div>\n\n'
      ),
      question$code_score,
      question$fill_score,
      question$total_score
    )
  )

  steps <- exam_question_steps(question)

  cat('<div class="step-list">\n')

  for (i in seq_along(steps)) {
    cat(
      sprintf(
        paste0(
          '<div class="step-row">',
          '<div class="step-index">步骤 %d</div>',
          '<div class="step-content">',
          '<div class="step-title">%s</div>',
          '<div class="step-text">%s</div>',
          '</div>',
          '</div>\n'
        ),
        i,
        steps[[i]]$title,
        steps[[i]]$text
      )
    )
  }

  cat('</div>\n\n')
}

# ===== 本机答题痕迹：稳定恢复模块 =====
# 设计原则：
# 1. learnr 自己的跨会话 storage 仍保持关闭，所以新打开默认一定是空白。
# 2. 答题痕迹另存为本机 RDS；只有学生主动点击“恢复上次答题”才读取。
# 3. 保存路径按 exam_id + student_id 区分，同一台电脑可保存多个学号。
# 4. 不修改 learnr 内部 R 状态，不使用高频 DOM 监听。

exam_code_labels <- unique(
  unlist(
    lapply(
      paper$questions,
      function(q) q$code_labels
    ),
    use.names = FALSE
  )
)

exam_fill_ids <- unique(
  unlist(
    lapply(
      paper$questions,
      function(q) {
        if (length(q$fills) == 0L) {
          return(character(0))
        }

        vapply(
          q$fills,
          function(f) f$id,
          character(1)
        )
      }
    ),
    use.names = FALSE
  )
)


# 每个代码框打开时自带的默认提示代码。
# 恢复统计时，这些默认内容不算“学生已经作答”。
exam_default_codes <- setNames(
  as.list(
    rep("", length(exam_code_labels))
  ),
  exam_code_labels
)

exam_normalize_code <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L) {
    return("")
  }

  x <- paste(
    as.character(x),
    collapse = "\n"
  )

  x <- gsub(
    "\r\n?",
    "\n",
    x
  )

  lines <- strsplit(
    x,
    "\n",
    fixed = TRUE
  )[[1]]

  lines <- sub(
    "[[:space:]]+$",
    "",
    lines
  )

  trimws(
    paste(
      lines,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

exam_code_is_meaningful <- function(
  label,
  code
) {
  value <- exam_normalize_code(code)

  if (!nzchar(value)) {
    return(FALSE)
  }

  default <- exam_default_codes[[label]]

  if (is.null(default)) {
    return(TRUE)
  }

  !identical(
    value,
    exam_normalize_code(default)
  )
}

exam_meaningful_codes <- function(codes) {
  if (
    is.null(codes) ||
    length(codes) == 0L
  ) {
    return(list())
  }

  keep <- vapply(
    names(codes),
    function(label) {
      exam_code_is_meaningful(
        label,
        codes[[label]]
      )
    },
    logical(1)
  )

  codes[keep]
}

exam_recovery_dir <- function() {
  path <- file.path(
    tools::R_user_dir(
      "RMedLearn",
      "data"
    ),
    "exam_recovery"
  )

  dir.create(
    path,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  path
}

exam_recovery_path <- function(student_id) {
  key <- paste(
    as.character(paper$exam_id),
    trimws(as.character(student_id)),
    sep = "|"
  )

  file.path(
    exam_recovery_dir(),
    paste0(
      digest::digest(
        key,
        algo = "sha256",
        serialize = FALSE
      ),
      ".rds"
    )
  )
}

exam_recovery_read <- function(student_id) {
  path <- exam_recovery_path(student_id)

  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  tryCatch(
    readRDS(path),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

exam_recovery_write <- function(student_id, state) {
  path <- exam_recovery_path(student_id)

  tmp <- tempfile(
    pattern = "rmedlearn_exam_",
    tmpdir = dirname(path),
    fileext = ".rds"
  )

  saveRDS(
    state,
    tmp,
    version = 2
  )

  ok <- file.copy(
    tmp,
    path,
    overwrite = TRUE
  )

  unlink(tmp)

  if (!isTRUE(ok)) {
    stop(
      "答题痕迹保存失败。",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  invisible(path)
}

exam_recovery_archive <- function(student_id) {
  path <- exam_recovery_path(student_id)

  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    return(invisible(FALSE))
  }

  archive_dir <- file.path(
    exam_recovery_dir(),
    "archive"
  )

  dir.create(
    archive_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  target <- file.path(
    archive_dir,
    paste0(
      tools::file_path_sans_ext(
        basename(path)
      ),
      "_",
      format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"),
      ".rds"
    )
  )

  file.copy(
    path,
    target,
    overwrite = FALSE
  )

  invisible(TRUE)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 本机当前考试锁
# ------------------------------------------------------------
exam_machine_lock_path <- function() {
  key <- paste0(
    "machine|",
    as.character(paper$exam_id)
  )

  file.path(
    exam_recovery_dir(),
    paste0(
      "active_",
      digest::digest(
        key,
        algo = "sha256",
        serialize = FALSE
      ),
      ".rds"
    )
  )
}

exam_machine_lock_write <- function(student_id) {
  path <- exam_machine_lock_path()

  state <- list(
    schema_version = 1L,
    exam_id = as.character(paper$exam_id),
    student_id = trimws(as.character(student_id)),
    updated_at = Sys.time()
  )

  tmp <- tempfile(
    pattern = "rmedlearn_machine_",
    tmpdir = dirname(path),
    fileext = ".rds"
  )

  saveRDS(state, tmp, version = 2)
  ok <- file.copy(tmp, path, overwrite = TRUE)
  unlink(tmp)

  if (!isTRUE(ok)) {
    stop("本机考试锁保存失败。", call. = FALSE)
  }

  invisible(path)
}

exam_machine_recovery_read <- function(hours = 2) {
  path <- exam_machine_lock_path()

  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)

  pointer <- tryCatch(
    readRDS(path),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (
    is.null(pointer) ||
    is.null(pointer$exam_id) ||
    is.null(pointer$student_id) ||
    !identical(as.character(pointer$exam_id), as.character(paper$exam_id))
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  saved <- exam_recovery_read(trimws(as.character(pointer$student_id)))

  if (
    is.null(saved) ||
    is.null(saved$exam_id) ||
    !identical(as.character(saved$exam_id), as.character(paper$exam_id))
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  started_at <- saved$started_at
  if (!inherits(started_at, "POSIXt")) {
    started_at <- tryCatch(
      as.POSIXct(started_at),
      error = function(e) NA
    )
  }

  # 2 小时内，本机锁定同一考生身份和随机数据编号。
  if (
    is.na(started_at) ||
    as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), started_at, units = "hours")) >= hours
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  saved
}

exam_blank_recovery_state <- function(
  student_id,
  class_name,
  student_name,
  dataset_id,
  started_at
) {
  list(
    schema_version = 2L,
    status = "active",
    student_id = student_id,
    class = class_name,
    name = student_name,
    exam_id = as.character(paper$exam_id),
    dataset_id = as.integer(dataset_id),
    started_at = started_at,
    last_saved_at = Sys.time(),
    codes = setNames(
      as.list(
        rep("", length(exam_code_labels))
      ),
      exam_code_labels
    ),
    fills = setNames(
      as.list(
        rep("", length(exam_fill_ids))
      ),
      exam_fill_ids
    ),
    location_hash = "",
    workdir = NULL,
    run_status = list(),
    dataset_verified = FALSE,
    submission_code = NULL,
    completed_at = NULL
  )
}

exam_code_display_name <- function(label) {
  for (q in paper$questions) {
    if (label %in% q$code_labels) {
      title <- as.character(q$title)

      if (identical(label, "q01_workdir")) {
        return(
          paste0(
            title,
            "（设置工作空间）"
          )
        )
      }

      if (identical(label, "q01_import")) {
        return(
          paste0(
            title,
            "（导入与查看数据）"
          )
        )
      }

      return(title)
    }
  }

  label
}

exam_run_status_make <- function(
  code,
  error_message = NULL,
  timeout_exceeded = FALSE
) {
  error_text <- if (
    is.null(error_message) ||
    length(error_message) == 0L
  ) {
    ""
  } else {
    trimws(
      paste(
        as.character(error_message),
        collapse = " "
      )
    )
  }

  timeout_flag <- isTRUE(
    timeout_exceeded
  )

  list(
    ran = TRUE,
    ok = !timeout_flag && !nzchar(error_text),
    code = exam_normalize_code(code),
    timeout = timeout_flag,
    error = error_text,
    ran_at = Sys.time()
  )
}

exam_code_precheck <- function(bucket) {
  run_status <- if (
    exists(
      ".run_status",
      envir = bucket,
      inherits = FALSE
    )
  ) {
    get(
      ".run_status",
      envir = bucket,
      inherits = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    list()
  }

  details <- lapply(
    exam_code_labels,
    function(label) {
      current_code <- if (
        exists(
          label,
          envir = bucket,
          inherits = FALSE
        )
      ) {
        get(
          label,
          envir = bucket,
          inherits = FALSE
        )
      } else {
        ""
      }

      current_code <- exam_normalize_code(
        current_code
      )

      title <- exam_code_display_name(
        label
      )

      if (
        !exam_code_is_meaningful(
          label,
          current_code
        )
      ) {
        return(
          list(
            label = label,
            title = title,
            status = "blank",
            text = "代码框为空"
          )
        )
      }

      last_run <- run_status[[label]]

      if (
        is.null(last_run) ||
        !isTRUE(last_run$ran)
      ) {
        return(
          list(
            label = label,
            title = title,
            status = "not_run",
            text = "已有代码，但尚未运行"
          )
        )
      }

      if (
        !identical(
          exam_normalize_code(
            last_run$code
          ),
          current_code
        )
      ) {
        return(
          list(
            label = label,
            title = title,
            status = "changed",
            text = "代码在上次运行后又被修改，尚未重新运行"
          )
        )
      }

      if (isTRUE(last_run$timeout)) {
        return(
          list(
            label = label,
            title = title,
            status = "failed",
            text = "最后一次运行超时"
          )
        )
      }

      if (!isTRUE(last_run$ok)) {
        return(
          list(
            label = label,
            title = title,
            status = "failed",
            text = "最后一次运行出现错误，未成功跑通"
          )
        )
      }

      list(
        label = label,
        title = title,
        status = "ok",
        text = "最后一次运行成功"
      )
    }
  )

  names(details) <- exam_code_labels
  details
}

exam_code_validation_record <- function(label, bucket) {
  current_code <- if (
    exists(label, envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)
  ) {
    get(label, envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)
  } else {
    ""
  }

  current_code <- exam_normalize_code(current_code)

  run_status <- if (
    exists(".run_status", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)
  ) {
    get(".run_status", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)
  } else {
    list()
  }

  last_run <- run_status[[label]]
  meaningful <- exam_code_is_meaningful(label, current_code)
  ran <- !is.null(last_run) && isTRUE(last_run$ran)

  current_matches_last_run <- isTRUE(ran) && identical(
    exam_normalize_code(last_run$code),
    current_code
  )

  validated <- isTRUE(ran) && isTRUE(current_matches_last_run)
  validation_passed <- isTRUE(validated) && isTRUE(last_run$ok)

  status <- if (!meaningful) {
    "blank"
  } else if (!ran) {
    "not_run"
  } else if (!current_matches_last_run) {
    "changed_after_run"
  } else if (isTRUE(last_run$timeout)) {
    "timeout"
  } else if (!isTRUE(last_run$ok)) {
    "failed"
  } else {
    "passed"
  }

  status_text <- switch(
    status,
    blank = "代码框为空",
    not_run = "已有代码，但尚未运行",
    changed_after_run = "代码在上次运行后又被修改，当前版本尚未重新运行",
    timeout = "当前代码最后一次运行超时",
    failed = "当前代码最后一次运行出现错误或校验失败",
    passed = "当前代码已经运行且运行校验通过",
    "状态未知"
  )

  ran_at <- if (
    !is.null(last_run) &&
    !is.null(last_run$ran_at) &&
    length(last_run$ran_at) == 1L
  ) {
    tryCatch(
      format(
        last_run$ran_at,
        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z"
      ),
      error = function(e) as.character(last_run$ran_at)
    )
  } else {
    ""
  }

  list(
    label = label,
    ran = isTRUE(ran),
    validated = isTRUE(validated),
    validation_passed = isTRUE(validation_passed),
    current_matches_last_run = isTRUE(current_matches_last_run),
    status = status,
    status_text = status_text,
    timeout = if (is.null(last_run)) FALSE else isTRUE(last_run$timeout),
    error = if (
      is.null(last_run) ||
      is.null(last_run$error)
    ) {
      ""
    } else {
      as.character(last_run$error)
    },
    ran_at = ran_at,
    dataset_verified = if (
      identical(label, "q01_import") &&
      !is.null(last_run) &&
      !is.null(last_run$dataset_verified)
    ) {
      isTRUE(last_run$dataset_verified)
    } else {
      NA
    },
    dataset_file = if (
      !is.null(last_run) &&
      !is.null(last_run$dataset_file)
    ) {
      as.character(last_run$dataset_file)
    } else {
      ""
    },
    dataset_expected_file = if (
      !is.null(last_run) &&
      !is.null(last_run$dataset_expected_file)
    ) {
      as.character(last_run$dataset_expected_file)
    } else {
      ""
    }
  )
}

exam_question_fill_ids <- function(label) {
  for (q in paper$questions) {
    if (label %in% unlist(q$code_labels, use.names = FALSE)) {
      if (length(q$fills) == 0L) return(character(0))
      return(vapply(q$fills, function(f) f$id, character(1)))
    }
  }
  character(0)
}

exam_fill_access_ok <- function(label, bucket) {
  ids <- exam_question_fill_ids(label)
  if (length(ids) == 0L) return(FALSE)
  q <- NULL
  for (one in paper$questions) {
    if (label %in% unlist(one$code_labels, use.names = FALSE)) q <- one
  }
  if (is.null(q)) return(FALSE)
  rs <- if (exists(".run_status", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) get(".run_status", envir = bucket) else list()
  all(vapply(unlist(q$code_labels, use.names = FALSE), function(lbl) {
    st <- rs[[lbl]]
    if (is.null(st) || !isTRUE(st$ran) || !isTRUE(st$ok)) return(FALSE)
    current <- if (exists(lbl, envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) get(lbl, envir = bucket) else ""
    identical(exam_normalize_code(st$code), exam_normalize_code(current))
  }, logical(1)))
}

exam_enabled_fill_ids <- function(bucket) {
  out <- character(0)
  for (q in paper$questions) {
    if (length(q$fills) == 0L) next
    labels <- unlist(q$code_labels, use.names = FALSE)
    if (length(labels) > 0L && all(vapply(labels, function(lbl) exam_fill_access_ok(lbl, bucket), logical(1)))) {
      out <- c(out, vapply(q$fills, function(f) f$id, character(1)))
    }
  }
  unique(out)
}

exam_activation_status <- function(saved, hours = 2) {
  if (is.null(saved) || is.null(saved$started_at)) return(list(locked = FALSE, remaining_minutes = 0))
  started <- saved$started_at
  if (!inherits(started, "POSIXt")) started <- tryCatch(as.POSIXct(started), error = function(e) NA)
  if (length(started) != 1L || is.na(started)) return(list(locked = FALSE, remaining_minutes = 0))
  elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), started, units = "hours"))
  remaining <- max(0, ceiling((hours - elapsed) * 60))
  list(locked = is.finite(elapsed) && elapsed < hours, remaining_minutes = remaining)
}

exam_extract_dataset_filename <- function(code) {
  exprs <- tryCatch(
    parse(text = paste(code, collapse = "\n")),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(exprs)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  found <- NULL

  walk_expr <- function(x) {
    if (!is.null(found) || !is.call(x)) {
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }

    fun_name <- tryCatch(
      as.character(x[[1]]),
      error = function(e) ""
    )

    if (fun_name %in% c("read.csv", "read.csv2", "read.table")) {
      if (length(x) >= 2L) {
        arg1 <- x[[2]]

        if (is.character(arg1) && length(arg1) == 1L) {
          found <<- as.character(arg1)
          return(invisible(NULL))
        }
      }

      nms <- names(x)
      if (!is.null(nms)) {
        file_idx <- which(nms == "file")
        if (length(file_idx) > 0L) {
          arg_file <- x[[file_idx[1]]]
          if (is.character(arg_file) && length(arg_file) == 1L) {
            found <<- as.character(arg_file)
            return(invisible(NULL))
          }
        }
      }
    }

    for (part in as.list(x)[-1]) {
      walk_expr(part)
    }

    invisible(NULL)
  }

  for (expr in exprs) {
    walk_expr(expr)
  }

  if (is.null(found) || !nzchar(trimws(found))) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  found
}


exam_dataset_hash_ok <- function(bucket, code = NULL) {
  if (!exists(".exam_workdir", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE) ||
      !exists(".dataset_id", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) {
    return(list(
      ok = FALSE,
      expected_file = NA_character_,
      actual_file = NA_character_,
      path = NA_character_,
      reason = "未检测到有效的考试工作目录或随机数据编号。"
    ))
  }

  wd <- get(".exam_workdir", envir = bucket)
  did <- as.integer(get(".dataset_id", envir = bucket))

  expected_file <- paste0("x", did, ".csv")
  actual_file <- exam_extract_dataset_filename(code)

  if (is.null(actual_file)) {
    return(list(
      ok = FALSE,
      expected_file = expected_file,
      actual_file = NA_character_,
      path = NA_character_,
      reason = paste0(
        "未能从本题代码中识别出 read.csv()/read.table() 实际导入的文件。"
      )
    ))
  }

  actual_file_clean <- basename(
    gsub("\\\\", "/", trimws(actual_file))
  )

  path <- if (
    exam_is_absolute_path(actual_file)
  ) {
    path.expand(actual_file)
  } else {
    file.path(wd, actual_file)
  }

  file_ok <- identical(
    tolower(actual_file_clean),
    tolower(expected_file)
  )

  hash_target <- if (
    !is.null(paper$dataset_hashes)
  ) {
    paper$dataset_hashes[[as.character(did)]]
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  exists_ok <- file.exists(path)
  hash_ok <- FALSE

  if (
    exists_ok &&
    !is.null(hash_target)
  ) {
    hash_ok <- identical(
      tolower(
        digest::digest(
          file = path,
          algo = "sha256",
          serialize = FALSE
        )
      ),
      tolower(
        as.character(hash_target)
      )
    )
  }

  ok <- isTRUE(file_ok) && isTRUE(exists_ok) && isTRUE(hash_ok)

  reason <- if (!file_ok) {
    paste0(
      "本次随机数据为 ",
      paste0("X", did),
      "，代码实际导入的是 ",
      actual_file_clean,
      "。"
    )
  } else if (!exists_ok) {
    paste0(
      "代码实际导入的文件不存在：",
      actual_file_clean,
      "。"
    )
  } else if (!hash_ok) {
    paste0(
      actual_file_clean,
      " 的文件内容与本次随机分配的 X",
      did,
      " 数据不一致。"
    )
  } else {
    "文件名和文件内容均与本次随机分配的数据一致。"
  }

  list(
    ok = ok,
    expected_file = expected_file,
    actual_file = actual_file_clean,
    path = path,
    reason = reason
  )
}

exam_recovery_touch_code <- function(
  student_id,
  label,
  code,
  bucket,
  run_status = NULL
) {
  state <- exam_recovery_read(student_id)

  if (is.null(state)) {
    state <- exam_blank_recovery_state(
      student_id = student_id,
      class_name = if (exists(".class", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) get(".class", envir = bucket) else "",
      student_name = if (exists(".name", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) get(".name", envir = bucket) else "",
      dataset_id = get(
        ".dataset_id",
        envir = bucket,
        inherits = FALSE
      ),
      started_at = get(
        ".started_at",
        envir = bucket,
        inherits = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  if (is.null(state$codes)) {
    state$codes <- setNames(
      as.list(
        rep("", length(exam_code_labels))
      ),
      exam_code_labels
    )
  }

  state$codes[[label]] <- if (
    exam_code_is_meaningful(
      label,
      code
    )
  ) {
    paste(
      code,
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  } else {
    ""
  }

  if (!is.null(run_status)) {
    if (is.null(state$run_status)) {
      state$run_status <- list()
    }

    state$run_status[[label]] <- run_status
  }

  state$last_saved_at <- Sys.time()

  if (
    exists(
      ".exam_workdir",
      envir = bucket,
      inherits = FALSE
    )
  ) {
    state$workdir <- get(
      ".exam_workdir",
      envir = bucket,
      inherits = FALSE
    )
  }

  if (exists(".dataset_verified", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) {
    state$dataset_verified <- isTRUE(get(".dataset_verified", envir = bucket))
  }

  exam_recovery_write(
    student_id,
    state
  )

  invisible(TRUE)
}
```

```{r exam-track-live-code, context="server-start", include=FALSE}
learnr::event_register_handler(
  "exercise_result",
  function(session, event, data) {
    if (!is.null(data$label) && !is.null(data$code)) {
      bucket <- exam_session_bucket(session)

      assign(
        data$label,
        data$code,
        envir = bucket
      )

      if (identical(data$label, "q01_workdir")) {
        wd <- exam_extract_setwd_path(data$code)

        if (!is.null(wd) && dir.exists(path.expand(wd))) {
          wd <- normalizePath(
            path.expand(wd),
            winslash = "/",
            mustWork = TRUE
          )

          assign(
            ".exam_workdir",
            wd,
            envir = bucket
          )
        }
      }

      # 每次 Run Code 后立即保存一次。
      if (
        exists(
          ".student_id",
          envir = bucket,
          inherits = FALSE
        ) &&
        exists(
          ".dataset_id",
          envir = bucket,
          inherits = FALSE
        ) &&
        exists(
          ".started_at",
          envir = bucket,
          inherits = FALSE
        )
      ) {
        student_id <- get(
          ".student_id",
          envir = bucket,
          inherits = FALSE
        )

        run_status <- exam_run_status_make(
          code = data$code,
          error_message = data$error_message,
          timeout_exceeded = data$timeout_exceeded
        )

        if (identical(data$label, "q02_code") && isTRUE(run_status$ok)) {
          verify <- exam_dataset_hash_ok(
            bucket = bucket,
            code = data$code
          )

          verified <- isTRUE(verify$ok)

          assign(
            ".dataset_verified",
            verified,
            envir = bucket
          )

          assign(
            ".dataset_file",
            if (is.na(verify$actual_file)) "" else verify$actual_file,
            envir = bucket
          )

          run_status$dataset_verified <- verified
          run_status$dataset_file <- verify$actual_file
          run_status$dataset_expected_file <- verify$expected_file

          if (!verified) {
            run_status$ok <- FALSE
            run_status$error <- verify$reason

            showNotification(
              paste0(
                "数据文件校验失败：",
                verify$reason
              ),
              type = "error",
              duration = 6
            )
          } else {
            showNotification(
              paste0(
                "数据文件校验通过：",
                verify$actual_file
              ),
              type = "message",
              duration = 3
            )
          }
        }

        current_run_status <- if (
          exists(
            ".run_status",
            envir = bucket,
            inherits = FALSE
          )
        ) {
          get(
            ".run_status",
            envir = bucket,
            inherits = FALSE
          )
        } else {
          list()
        }

        current_run_status[[data$label]] <- run_status

        assign(
          ".run_status",
          current_run_status,
          envir = bucket
        )

        fill_ids_now <- exam_question_fill_ids(data$label)
        if (length(fill_ids_now) > 0L) {
          session$sendCustomMessage(
            "examFillAccess",
            list(
              ids = fill_ids_now,
              enabled = isTRUE(exam_fill_access_ok(data$label, bucket))
            )
          )
        }

        try(
          exam_recovery_touch_code(
            student_id = student_id,
            label = data$label,
            code = data$code,
            bucket = bucket,
            run_status = run_status
          ),
          silent = TRUE
        )
      }
    }
  }
)
```

```{r exam-server, context="server", include=FALSE}
student_id_state <- reactiveVal(NULL)
class_state <- reactiveVal(NULL)
name_state <- reactiveVal(NULL)
entry_mode_state <- reactiveVal(NULL)
last_saved_state <- reactiveVal(NULL)
pending_new_id <- reactiveVal(NULL)
submit_stage <- reactiveVal("idle")

# 本机是否存在本场考试 2 小时内的可恢复记录。
machine_recovery_state <- reactiveVal(
  exam_machine_recovery_read(hours = 2)
)

session$onFlushed(
  function() {
    # onFlushed() 回调本身不属于 Shiny reactive consumer。
    # 读取 reactiveVal 时必须用 isolate()，否则会报：
    # Operation not allowed without an active reactive context.
    saved <- isolate(
      machine_recovery_state()
    )

    if (is.null(saved)) {
      session$sendCustomMessage(
        "examEntryState",
        list(mode = "new")
      )
    } else {
      session$sendCustomMessage(
        "examEntryState",
        list(
          mode = "recovery",
          class_name = if (is.null(saved$class)) "" else as.character(saved$class),
          student_id = if (is.null(saved$student_id)) "" else as.character(saved$student_id),
          student_name = if (is.null(saved$name)) "" else as.character(saved$name),
          dataset_id = if (is.null(saved$dataset_id)) NA_integer_ else as.integer(saved$dataset_id)
        )
      )
    }
  },
  once = TRUE
)

# 填空题变化时立即保存。
for (fill_id in exam_fill_ids) {
  local({
    id <- fill_id

    observeEvent(
      input[[id]],
      {
        bucket <- exam_session_bucket(session)

        if (
          !exists(
            ".student_id",
            envir = bucket,
            inherits = FALSE
          )
        ) {
          return()
        }

        student_id <- get(
          ".student_id",
          envir = bucket,
          inherits = FALSE
        )

        state <- exam_recovery_read(student_id)

        if (is.null(state)) {
          return()
        }

        if (is.null(state$fills)) {
          state$fills <- setNames(
            as.list(
              rep("", length(exam_fill_ids))
            ),
            exam_fill_ids
          )
        }

        value <- input[[id]]

        if (!is.null(value) && nzchar(trimws(as.character(value))) &&
            is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(trimws(as.character(value)))))) {
          showNotification(
            "填空题应填写数值；请不要输入单位、百分号或其他文字。",
            type = "warning",
            duration = 4
          )
        }

        state$fills[[id]] <- if (is.null(value)) {
          ""
        } else {
          as.character(value)
        }

        state$last_saved_at <- Sys.time()

        try(
          exam_recovery_write(
            student_id,
            state
          ),
          silent = TRUE
        )
      },
      ignoreNULL = TRUE
    )
  })
}

exam_start_new_session <- function(
  id,
  class_name,
  student_name,
  archive_existing = FALSE
) {
  bucket <- exam_session_bucket(session)
  if (exists(".student_id", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) {
    showNotification("本次考试已经进入答题状态。", type = "warning")
    return(invisible(FALSE))
  }
  if (isTRUE(archive_existing)) try(exam_recovery_archive(id), silent = TRUE)

  dataset_count <- if (!is.null(paper$dataset_count)) as.integer(paper$dataset_count) else 10L
  dataset_id <- sample.int(dataset_count, 1L)
  started_at <- Sys.time()

  assign(".student_id", id, envir = bucket)
  assign(".class", class_name, envir = bucket)
  assign(".name", student_name, envir = bucket)
  assign(".dataset_id", dataset_id, envir = bucket)
  assign(".dataset_verified", FALSE, envir = bucket)
  assign(".started_at", started_at, envir = bucket)
  assign(".run_status", list(), envir = bucket)

  for (label in exam_code_labels) {
    if (exists(label, envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) rm(list = label, envir = bucket)
  }

  state <- exam_blank_recovery_state(
    student_id = id,
    class_name = class_name,
    student_name = student_name,
    dataset_id = dataset_id,
    started_at = started_at
  )
  try(exam_recovery_write(id, state), silent = TRUE)
  try(exam_machine_lock_write(id), silent = TRUE)
  machine_recovery_state(state)

  student_id_state(id)
  class_state(class_name)
  name_state(student_name)
  entry_mode_state("new")
  last_saved_state(format(state$last_saved_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))

  session$sendCustomMessage(
    "examReady",
    list(
      mode = "new",
      code_labels = exam_code_labels,
      fill_ids = exam_fill_ids,
      enabled_fill_ids = character(0)
    )
  )

  showNotification(paste0("考试已激活，本次数据编号为 X", dataset_id, "。"), type = "message", duration = 4)
  invisible(TRUE)
}

observeEvent(input$start_new_exam, {
  machine_saved <- exam_machine_recovery_read(hours = 2)

  if (!is.null(machine_saved)) {
    showNotification(
      "本机已存在本场考试的有效答题记录，请点击“恢复上次答题”。",
      type = "warning",
      duration = 5
    )
    return()
  }

  id <- trimws(input$student_id)
  class_name <- trimws(input$class_name)
  student_name <- trimws(input$student_name)

  if (!nzchar(id) || !nzchar(class_name) || !nzchar(student_name)) {
    showNotification("请完整填写班级、学号和姓名。", type = "error")
    return()
  }

  bucket <- exam_session_bucket(session)
  if (exists(".student_id", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) {
    showNotification("本次考试已经进入答题状态。", type = "warning")
    return()
  }

  old <- exam_recovery_read(id)
  if (!is.null(old)) {
    activation <- exam_activation_status(old, hours = 2)
    if (isTRUE(activation$locked)) {
      showModal(
        modalDialog(
          title = "本学号已激活考试",
          tags$p(paste0("距离本次激活满 2 小时约还有 ", activation$remaining_minutes, " 分钟。")),
          tags$p("如果是误关、断网、RStudio 关闭或电脑重启，请返回首页点击“恢复上次答题”，不要重新激活。"),
          easyClose = TRUE
        )
      )
      return()
    }

    pending_new_id(
      list(
        id = id,
        class_name = class_name,
        student_name = student_name,
        archive_existing = TRUE
      )
    )

    showModal(
      modalDialog(
        title = "请确认考生信息",
        tags$div(
          style = "font-size:16px; line-height:1.9;",
          tags$p("请核对以下信息："),
          tags$div(
            style = "padding:14px 18px; background:#f5f7fa; border-radius:6px; margin-bottom:14px;",
            tags$p(tags$strong("班级："), class_name),
            tags$p(tags$strong("学号："), id),
            tags$p(tags$strong("姓名："), student_name)
          ),
          tags$p(
            style = "color:#b45f06; font-weight:600;",
            "该学号存在超过 2 小时的历史考试记录。确认后将创建新的空白答卷，并重新随机分配数据集。"
          ),
          tags$p(
            "确认开始后，本机将锁定以上班级、学号、姓名和本次随机数据编号；首次激活后的 2 小时内不能重新激活或重置考试，误关闭后只能恢复原答卷。若信息有误，请点击“返回修改”。"
          )
        ),
        footer = tagList(
          modalButton("返回修改"),
          actionButton(
            "confirm_start_new",
            "确认无误，开始考试",
            class = "btn-primary"
          )
        ),
        easyClose = FALSE
      )
    )
    return()
  }

  # 第一次激活时先进行二次确认，不立即创建考试记录。
  pending_new_id(
    list(
      id = id,
      class_name = class_name,
      student_name = student_name,
      archive_existing = FALSE
    )
  )

  showModal(
    modalDialog(
      title = "请确认考生信息",
      tags$div(
        style = "font-size:16px; line-height:1.9;",
        tags$p("请核对以下信息："),
        tags$div(
          style = "padding:14px 18px; background:#f5f7fa; border-radius:6px; margin-bottom:14px;",
          tags$p(tags$strong("班级："), class_name),
          tags$p(tags$strong("学号："), id),
          tags$p(tags$strong("姓名："), student_name)
        ),
        tags$p(
          style = "color:#b45f06; font-weight:600;",
          "确认开始后，本机将锁定以上考生信息，并随机分配 X1–X10 中的一套数据；首次激活后的 2 小时内不能重新激活或重置考试。"
        ),
        tags$p(
          "请务必确认班级、学号和姓名填写正确。若信息有误，请点击“返回修改”。"
        )
      ),
      footer = tagList(
        modalButton("返回修改"),
        actionButton(
          "confirm_start_new",
          "确认无误，开始考试",
          class = "btn-primary"
        )
      ),
      easyClose = FALSE
    )
  )
})

observeEvent(input$confirm_start_new, {
  info <- pending_new_id()

  if (is.null(info)) {
    removeModal()
    return()
  }

  # 再次检查本机锁，避免确认窗口停留期间产生重复激活。
  machine_saved <- exam_machine_recovery_read(hours = 2)

  if (!is.null(machine_saved)) {
    removeModal()
    pending_new_id(NULL)

    showNotification(
      "本机已经存在有效考试记录，请使用“恢复上次答题”。",
      type = "warning",
      duration = 5
    )
    return()
  }

  removeModal()

  exam_start_new_session(
    info$id,
    info$class_name,
    info$student_name,
    archive_existing = isTRUE(info$archive_existing)
  )

  pending_new_id(NULL)
})


observeEvent(input$restore_exam, {
  bucket <- exam_session_bucket(session)

  if (exists(".student_id", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) {
    showNotification(
      "本次考试已经进入答题状态。",
      type = "warning"
    )
    return()
  }

  # 直接读取“本机 + 本场考试”的当前答题记录。
  # 不再要求学生重新输入班级、学号和姓名。
  saved <- exam_machine_recovery_read(hours = 2)

  if (is.null(saved)) {
    showModal(
      modalDialog(
        title = "当前没有可恢复的答题记录",
        tags$p("本机未检测到本场考试 2 小时内的有效答题记录。"),
        tags$p("如果这是第一次进入考试，请填写班级、学号和姓名后点击“激活开始考试”。"),
        easyClose = TRUE
      )
    )
    return()
  }

  id <- trimws(as.character(saved$student_id))
  class_name <- if (is.null(saved$class)) "" else trimws(as.character(saved$class))
  student_name <- if (is.null(saved$name)) "" else trimws(as.character(saved$name))
  expected_dataset <- as.integer(saved$dataset_id)

  valid_student <- nzchar(id)
  valid_exam <- identical(as.character(saved$exam_id), as.character(paper$exam_id))
  valid_dataset <- length(expected_dataset) == 1L && !is.na(expected_dataset) && expected_dataset >= 1L

  if (!isTRUE(valid_student) || !isTRUE(valid_exam) || !isTRUE(valid_dataset)) {
    showModal(
      modalDialog(
        title = "答题记录校验失败",
        "本机答题记录中的考试信息或数据编号异常。为避免恢复错误答卷，系统已停止恢复。",
        easyClose = TRUE
      )
    )
    return()
  }

  started_at <- saved$started_at

  if (!inherits(started_at, "POSIXt")) {
    started_at <- tryCatch(
      as.POSIXct(started_at),
      error = function(e) Sys.time()
    )
  }

  assign(".student_id", id, envir = bucket)
  assign(".class", if (is.null(saved$class)) class_name else as.character(saved$class), envir = bucket)
  assign(".name", if (is.null(saved$name)) student_name else as.character(saved$name), envir = bucket)
  assign(".dataset_verified", isTRUE(saved$dataset_verified), envir = bucket)

  assign(
    ".dataset_id",
    expected_dataset,
    envir = bucket
  )

  assign(
    ".started_at",
    started_at,
    envir = bucket
  )

  assign(
    ".run_status",
    if (is.null(saved$run_status)) {
      list()
    } else {
      saved$run_status
    },
    envir = bucket
  )

  if (!is.null(saved$codes)) {
    for (label in intersect(
      names(saved$codes),
      exam_code_labels
    )) {
      assign(
        label,
        as.character(saved$codes[[label]]),
        envir = bucket
      )
    }
  }

  if (
    !is.null(saved$workdir) &&
    is.character(saved$workdir) &&
    length(saved$workdir) == 1L &&
    dir.exists(path.expand(saved$workdir))
  ) {
    wd <- normalizePath(
      path.expand(saved$workdir),
      winslash = "/",
      mustWork = TRUE
    )

    assign(
      ".exam_workdir",
      wd,
      envir = bucket
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(saved$fills)) {
    for (fill_id in intersect(
      names(saved$fills),
      exam_fill_ids
    )) {
      try(
        updateTextInput(
          session,
          fill_id,
          value = as.character(
            saved$fills[[fill_id]]
          )
        ),
        silent = TRUE
      )
    }
  }

  student_id_state(id)
  class_state(class_name)
  name_state(student_name)
  entry_mode_state("restored")
  machine_recovery_state(saved)

  updateTextInput(session, "class_name", value = class_name)
  updateTextInput(session, "student_id", value = id)
  updateTextInput(session, "student_name", value = student_name)
  try(exam_machine_lock_write(id), silent = TRUE)

  saved_at_text <- if (
    !is.null(saved$last_saved_at)
  ) {
    format(
      saved$last_saved_at,
      "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
    )
  } else {
    ""
  }

  last_saved_state(saved_at_text)

  session$sendCustomMessage(
    "examReady",
    list(
      mode = "restored",
      code_labels = exam_code_labels,
      fill_ids = exam_fill_ids,
      enabled_fill_ids = exam_enabled_fill_ids(bucket)
    )
  )

  meaningful_codes <- exam_meaningful_codes(
    saved$codes
  )

  # 顺手清理旧版恢复文件中保存的默认提示代码。
  # 这样同一学号下次恢复时，统计数字也会保持正确。
  if (!is.null(saved$codes)) {
    cleaned_codes <- setNames(
      as.list(
        rep("", length(exam_code_labels))
      ),
      exam_code_labels
    )

    for (label in names(meaningful_codes)) {
      cleaned_codes[[label]] <- meaningful_codes[[label]]
    }

    saved$codes <- cleaned_codes

    try(
      exam_recovery_write(
        id,
        saved
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )
  }

  payload <- list(
    codes = meaningful_codes,
    fills = saved$fills,
    location_hash = saved$location_hash
  )

  # 等本轮 UI 刷新后再写回编辑器。
  # 注意：只恢复文本，不触发 Run Code，也不触发 exercise restore 事件。
  session$onFlushed(
    function() {
      session$sendCustomMessage(
        "restoreExamState",
        payload
      )
    },
    once = TRUE
  )

  restored_code_n <- length(
    meaningful_codes
  )

  restored_fill_n <- if (is.null(saved$fills)) {
    0L
  } else {
    sum(
      vapply(
        saved$fills,
        function(x) {
          nzchar(
            trimws(as.character(x))
          )
        },
        logical(1)
      )
    )
  }

  showNotification(
    paste0(
      "已读取本机记录：",
      restored_code_n,
      " 个代码框，",
      restored_fill_n,
      " 个填空项。"
    ),
    type = "message",
    duration = 5
  )
})

# 每 5 秒由浏览器发送一次轻量答题快照。
# 同时保存：
# - 已输入但尚未点击 Run Code 的代码
# - 当前已经渲染的填空答案
# 这也是填空题 observeEvent 之外的第二层恢复保障。
observeEvent(input$recovery_snapshot, {
  bucket <- exam_session_bucket(session)

  if (
    !exists(
      ".student_id",
      envir = bucket,
      inherits = FALSE
    )
  ) {
    return()
  }

  snap <- input$recovery_snapshot

  if (is.null(snap)) {
    return()
  }

  student_id <- get(
    ".student_id",
    envir = bucket,
    inherits = FALSE
  )

  if (
    is.null(snap$student_id) ||
    !identical(
      trimws(as.character(snap$student_id)),
      trimws(as.character(student_id))
    )
  ) {
    return()
  }

  state <- exam_recovery_read(student_id)

  if (is.null(state)) {
    return()
  }

  if (!is.null(snap$codes)) {
    if (is.null(state$codes)) {
      state$codes <- setNames(
        as.list(
          rep("", length(exam_code_labels))
        ),
        exam_code_labels
      )
    }

    for (label in intersect(
      names(snap$codes),
      exam_code_labels
    )) {
      value <- snap$codes[[label]]

      if (!is.null(value)) {
        cleaned_value <- if (
          exam_code_is_meaningful(
            label,
            value
          )
        ) {
          as.character(value)
        } else {
          ""
        }

        state$codes[[label]] <- cleaned_value

        if (nzchar(cleaned_value)) {
          assign(
            label,
            cleaned_value,
            envir = bucket
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }

  # 第二层保障：浏览器每 5 秒同步当前已渲染的填空答案。
  # 这样即使 learnr 切换 Topic 时某个 textInput 的单次 change 事件漏掉，
  # 填空仍会写入本机恢复记录。
  if (!is.null(snap$fills)) {
    if (is.null(state$fills)) {
      state$fills <- setNames(
        as.list(
          rep("", length(exam_fill_ids))
        ),
        exam_fill_ids
      )
    }

    for (fill_id in intersect(
      names(snap$fills),
      exam_fill_ids
    )) {
      value <- snap$fills[[fill_id]]

      if (!is.null(value)) {
        state$fills[[fill_id]] <- as.character(
          value
        )
      }
    }
  }

  if (
    !is.null(snap$location_hash) &&
    length(snap$location_hash) == 1L
  ) {
    state$location_hash <- as.character(
      snap$location_hash
    )
  }

  if (
    exists(
      ".exam_workdir",
      envir = bucket,
      inherits = FALSE
    )
  ) {
    state$workdir <- get(
      ".exam_workdir",
      envir = bucket,
      inherits = FALSE
    )
  }

  state$last_saved_at <- Sys.time()

  try(
    exam_recovery_write(
      student_id,
      state
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
})

observeEvent(input$finish_exam, {
  bucket <- exam_session_bucket(session)

  if (!exists(".student_id", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) {
    showNotification(
      "请先输入学号并选择进入方式。",
      type = "error"
    )
    return()
  }

  code_check <- exam_code_precheck(
    bucket
  )

  problem_items <- Filter(
    function(x) {
      !identical(
        x$status,
        "ok"
      )
    },
    code_check
  )

  ok_n <- sum(
    vapply(
      code_check,
      function(x) identical(
        x$status,
        "ok"
      ),
      logical(1)
    )
  )

  problem_n <- length(
    problem_items
  )

  body <- if (problem_n == 0L) {
    tags$div(
      class = "code-precheck-ok",
      tags$strong(
        "代码运行检查通过"
      ),
      tags$p(
        paste0(
          "共检查 ",
          length(code_check),
          " 个代码框：均已填写，并且当前代码与最后一次成功运行的代码一致。"
        )
      ),
      tags$p(
        class = "code-precheck-note",
        "这里只检查代码是否为空、是否成功运行，不判断答案是否正确。"
      )
    )
  } else {
    tags$div(
      class = "code-precheck-warning",

      tags$div(
        class = "code-precheck-summary",
        tags$strong(
          paste0(
            "发现 ",
            problem_n,
            " 个代码框需要检查"
          )
        ),
        tags$span(
          paste0(
            "（",
            ok_n,
            " 个代码框最后一次运行成功）"
          )
        )
      ),

      tags$p(
        "以下代码框为空、尚未运行、修改后未重新运行，或最后一次运行出现错误："
      ),

      tags$ul(
        class = "code-precheck-list",
        lapply(
          problem_items,
          function(item) {
            tags$li(
              tags$strong(
                item$title
              ),
              tags$span(
                paste0(
                  "：",
                  item$text
                )
              )
            )
          }
        )
      ),

      tags$p(
        class = "code-precheck-note",
        "建议返回考试逐项检查。这里只检查代码是否为空、是否成功运行，不判断答案是否正确。"
      )
    )
  }

  submit_stage("code_check")

  showModal(
    modalDialog(
      title = "第一步：代码运行检查",
      body,
      footer = tagList(
        modalButton("返回考试检查"),
        actionButton(
          "continue_to_format_check",
          "下一步：检查结果填写格式",
          class = "btn-primary"
        )
      ),
      easyClose = FALSE,
      size = "l"
    )
  )
})

observeEvent(input$continue_to_format_check, {
  if (!identical(
    submit_stage(),
    "code_check"
  )) {
    return()
  }

  submit_stage("format_check")

  fill_problem_items <- list()
  for (q in paper$questions) {
    if (length(q$fills) == 0L) next
    for (f in q$fills) {
      val <- input[[f$id]]
      val <- if (is.null(val)) "" else trimws(as.character(val))
      if (!nzchar(val)) {
        fill_problem_items[[length(fill_problem_items) + 1L]] <- paste0(q$title, "：", f$label, "为空")
      } else if (is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(val)))) {
        fill_problem_items[[length(fill_problem_items) + 1L]] <- paste0(q$title, "：", f$label, "不是数值")
      }
    }
  }

  showModal(
    modalDialog(
      title = "第二步：结果填写与提交确认",

      tags$p("生成考试提交码前，请再次确认所有填空结果均符合以下格式要求。"),
      exam_format_full_ui(),
      if (length(fill_problem_items) > 0L) {
        tags$div(
          class = "code-precheck-warning",
          tags$strong("以下填空为空或不是数值；允许继续提交，但这些项目将按错误处理："),
          tags$ul(lapply(fill_problem_items, tags$li))
        )
      } else {
        tags$div(class = "code-precheck-ok", "填空格式初步检查通过。")
      },
      tags$hr(),
      checkboxInput(
        "format_checked",
        "我已检查全部结果填写格式，并确认空白/非数值项目将按错误处理。",
        value = FALSE
      ),
      checkboxInput(
        "proctor_checked",
        "我已提醒监考老师，并获得允许提交。",
        value = FALSE
      ),

      footer = tagList(
        modalButton("返回考试检查"),
        actionButton(
          "confirm_finish",
          "生成考试提交码",
          class = "btn-primary"
        )
      ),

      easyClose = FALSE,
      size = "l"
    )
  )
})

observeEvent(input$confirm_finish, {
  if (!identical(
    submit_stage(),
    "format_check"
  )) {
    showNotification(
      "请先完成代码运行检查和结果填写格式检查。",
      type = "error"
    )
    return()
  }

  if (!isTRUE(input$format_checked)) {
    showNotification("请先勾选结果填写格式确认。", type = "error")
    return()
  }
  if (!isTRUE(input$proctor_checked)) {
    showNotification("请先提醒监考老师，并勾选监考确认。", type = "error")
    return()
  }

  bucket <- exam_session_bucket(session)

  student_id <- get(".student_id", envir = bucket)
  dataset_id <- get(".dataset_id", envir = bucket)
  started_at <- get(".started_at", envir = bucket)
  completed_at <- Sys.time()

  lock <- getFromNamespace(
    "exam_lock_status",
    "RMedLearn"
  )(
    student_id = student_id,
    exam_id = paper$exam_id,
    hours = 2
  )

  if (isTRUE(lock$locked)) {
    removeModal()

    showModal(
      modalDialog(
        title = "暂时无法重复导出",
        paste0(
          "该学号在本试卷最近已经导出过考试记录。约 ",
          lock$remaining_minutes,
          " 分钟后才能再次导出。"
        ),
        easyClose = TRUE
      )
    )
    return()
  }

  question_records <- lapply(
    paper$questions,
    function(q) {
      codes <- lapply(
        q$code_labels,
        function(label) {
          if (exists(label, envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) {
            paste(
              get(label, envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE),
              collapse = "\n"
            )
          } else {
            ""
          }
        }
      )

      names(codes) <- q$code_labels

      fills <- lapply(
        q$fills,
        function(f) {
          value <- input[[f$id]]

          if (is.null(value)) {
            ""
          } else {
            as.character(value)
          }
        }
      )

      if (length(q$fills) > 0L) {
        names(fills) <- vapply(
          q$fills,
          function(f) f$id,
          character(1)
        )
      }

      code_validation <- lapply(
        q$code_labels,
        function(label) {
          exam_code_validation_record(
            label = label,
            bucket = bucket
          )
        }
      )

      names(code_validation) <- q$code_labels

      validation_statuses <- if (
        length(code_validation) > 0L
      ) {
        vapply(
          code_validation,
          function(x) as.character(x$status),
          character(1)
        )
      } else {
        character(0)
      }

      question_validation_status <- if (
        length(validation_statuses) == 0L
      ) {
        "not_applicable"
      } else if (all(validation_statuses == "passed")) {
        "passed"
      } else if (any(validation_statuses == "changed_after_run")) {
        "changed_after_run"
      } else if (any(validation_statuses %in% c("failed", "timeout"))) {
        "failed"
      } else if (any(validation_statuses == "not_run")) {
        "not_run"
      } else if (any(validation_statuses == "blank")) {
        "blank"
      } else {
        "mixed"
      }

      list(
        question_id = q$id,
        title = q$title,
        question_text = q$text,
        code_answers = codes,
        fill_answers = fills,
        code_validation = code_validation,
        code_validation_status = question_validation_status,
        code_validation_all_passed = identical(
          question_validation_status,
          "passed"
        ),
        correct = NA,
        score = NA
      )
    }
  )

  submitted_at <- Sys.time()

  record <- list(
    schema_version = 3L,
    code_validation_scope = "runtime_and_dataset_validation",
    class = if (exists(".class", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) get(".class", envir = bucket) else "",
    student_id = student_id,
    name = if (exists(".name", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) get(".name", envir = bucket) else "",
    dataset_id = dataset_id,
    dataset_verified = if (exists(".dataset_verified", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) isTRUE(get(".dataset_verified", envir = bucket)) else FALSE,
    exam_id = paper$exam_id,
    exam_title = paper$title,
    started_at = format(
      started_at,
      "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z"
    ),
    completed_at = format(
      completed_at,
      "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z"
    ),
    submitted_at = format(
      submitted_at,
      "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z"
    ),
    elapsed_minutes = round(
      as.numeric(
        difftime(
          completed_at,
          started_at,
          units = "mins"
        )
      ),
      2
    ),
    questions = question_records,
    grading_status = "pending_teacher_grading",
    total_score = NA
  )

  code_fun <- getFromNamespace(
    "encode_exam_submission",
    "RMedLearn"
  )

  submission_code <- code_fun(record)

  assign(
    ".submission_code",
    submission_code,
    envir = bucket
  )

  lock_fun <- getFromNamespace(
    "write_exam_lock",
    "RMedLearn"
  )

  lock_fun(
    student_id = student_id,
    exam_id = paper$exam_id,
    submitted_at = submitted_at
  )

  # 保留最后一次恢复记录，并标记为已完成。
  final_state <- exam_recovery_read(student_id)

  if (!is.null(final_state)) {
    final_state$status <- "completed"
    final_state$class <- if (exists(".class", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) get(".class", envir = bucket) else ""
    final_state$name <- if (exists(".name", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) get(".name", envir = bucket) else ""
    final_state$dataset_verified <- if (exists(".dataset_verified", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) isTRUE(get(".dataset_verified", envir = bucket)) else FALSE
    final_state$submission_code <- submission_code
    final_state$completed_at <- completed_at
    final_state$last_saved_at <- Sys.time()

    final_codes <- list()
    final_fills <- list()

    for (q in question_records) {
      if (length(q$code_answers) > 0L) {
        final_codes <- c(
          final_codes,
          q$code_answers
        )
      }

      if (length(q$fill_answers) > 0L) {
        final_fills <- c(
          final_fills,
          q$fill_answers
        )
      }
    }

    final_state$codes <- final_codes
    final_state$fills <- final_fills

    try(
      exam_recovery_write(
        student_id,
        final_state
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )
  }

  removeModal()
  submit_stage("completed")

  output$submission_summary <- renderUI({
    elapsed <- round(
      as.numeric(
        difftime(
          completed_at,
          started_at,
          units = "mins"
        )
      ),
      2
    )

    tags$div(
      class = "submission-card",

      tags$div(
        class = "submission-header",
        tags$div(
          class = "submission-title",
          "考试记录已生成"
        ),
        tags$div(
          class = "submission-subtitle",
          "请复制并按教师要求提交下方考试提交码。"
        )
      ),

      tags$div(
        class = "submission-meta-grid",

        tags$div(
          class = "submission-meta-item",
          tags$span(
            class = "submission-meta-label",
            "考生"
          ),
          tags$strong(paste0(if (exists(".class", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) get(".class", envir = bucket) else "", " · ", student_id, " · ", if (exists(".name", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) get(".name", envir = bucket) else ""))
        ),

        tags$div(
          class = "submission-meta-item",
          tags$span(
            class = "submission-meta-label",
            "用时"
          ),
          tags$strong(
            paste0(elapsed, " 分钟")
          )
        ),

        tags$div(
          class = "submission-meta-item",
          tags$span(
            class = "submission-meta-label",
            "开始时间"
          ),
          tags$span(
            format(
              started_at,
              "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
            )
          )
        ),

        tags$div(
          class = "submission-meta-item",
          tags$span(
            class = "submission-meta-label",
            "完成时间"
          ),
          tags$span(
            format(
              completed_at,
              "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
            )
          )
        )
      ),

      tags$div(
        class = "submission-note",
        "考试页面不显示正确/错误与总分，成绩由教师端统一判定。"
      )
    )
  })

  output$submission_code_box <- renderUI({
    tags$div(
      class = "submission-code-wrap",

      tags$div(
        class = "submission-code-label",
        "考试提交码"
      ),

      tags$div(
        class = "submission-code-help",
        "点击下方“复制并保存考试提交码”后，系统会将提交码复制到剪贴板，并在考试工作空间生成“学号_姓名.txt”。若自动复制被阻止，可在文本框内按 Ctrl+A，再按 Ctrl+C。"
      ),

      textAreaInput(
        "submission_code_display",
        label = NULL,
        value = submission_code,
        rows = 7,
        width = "100%"
      )
    )
  })

  session$sendCustomMessage(
    "showSubmission",
    TRUE
  )
})

observeEvent(input$copy_save_submission_code, {
  bucket <- exam_session_bucket(session)

  if (!exists(".submission_code", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) {
    showNotification(
      "尚未生成考试提交码。",
      type = "error"
    )
    return()
  }

  code <- as.character(
    get(".submission_code", envir = bucket)
  )

  sid <- if (exists(".student_id", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) {
    as.character(get(".student_id", envir = bucket))
  } else {
    "student"
  }

  nm <- if (exists(".name", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)) {
    as.character(get(".name", envir = bucket))
  } else {
    ""
  }

  # 清理 Windows 文件名中的非法字符，同时避免结尾空格/句点。
  clean_file_part <- function(x, fallback) {
    x <- trimws(as.character(x))
    x <- gsub('[\\/:*?"<>|]', "_", x)
    x <- gsub("[[:cntrl:]]", "", x)
    x <- sub("[. ]+$", "", x)
    if (!nzchar(x)) fallback else x
  }

  safe_sid <- clean_file_part(sid, "student")
  safe_nm <- clean_file_part(nm, "name")
  file_name <- paste0(safe_sid, "_", safe_nm, ".txt")

  save_result <- list(
    ok = FALSE,
    path = "",
    file_name = file_name,
    message = "尚未设置考试工作空间。"
  )

  if (
    exists(".exam_workdir", envir = bucket, inherits = FALSE)
  ) {
    workdir <- as.character(
      get(".exam_workdir", envir = bucket)
    )

    if (length(workdir) == 1L && dir.exists(workdir)) {
      out_file <- file.path(
        workdir,
        file_name
      )

      err <- tryCatch(
        {
          # txt 文件只保存提交码本身，便于直接上交和批量读取。
          writeLines(
            code,
            out_file,
            useBytes = TRUE
          )
          NULL
        },
        error = function(e) e
      )

      if (is.null(err)) {
        save_result$ok <- TRUE
        save_result$path <- normalizePath(
          out_file,
          winslash = "/",
          mustWork = FALSE
        )
        save_result$message <- ""
      } else {
        save_result$message <- conditionMessage(err)
      }
    } else {
      save_result$message <- "考试工作空间不存在或已被移动。"
    }
  }

  assign(
    ".submission_save_result",
    save_result,
    envir = bucket
  )

  # 同一个按钮同时触发浏览器剪贴板复制。
  session$sendCustomMessage(
    "copyText",
    list(
      text = code
    )
  )
})

observeEvent(input$submission_copy_result, {
  res <- input$submission_copy_result
  bucket <- exam_session_bucket(session)

  save_res <- if (
    exists(
      ".submission_save_result",
      envir = bucket,
      inherits = FALSE
    )
  ) {
    get(
      ".submission_save_result",
      envir = bucket
    )
  } else {
    list(
      ok = FALSE,
      path = "",
      file_name = "",
      message = "未获取到文件保存状态。"
    )
  }

  copy_ok <- isTRUE(res$ok)
  save_ok <- isTRUE(save_res$ok)

  if (copy_ok && save_ok) {
    showNotification(
      paste0(
        "考试提交码已复制到剪贴板，并已保存到考试工作空间：",
        save_res$file_name
      ),
      type = "message",
      duration = 7
    )
    return()
  }

  if (copy_ok && !save_ok) {
    showNotification(
      paste0(
        "提交码已复制到剪贴板，但 txt 文件未能保存到考试工作空间：",
        if (!is.null(save_res$message) && nzchar(save_res$message)) {
          save_res$message
        } else {
          "未知原因"
        }
      ),
      type = "warning",
      duration = 9
    )
    return()
  }

  if (!copy_ok && save_ok) {
    showNotification(
      paste0(
        "txt 文件已保存到考试工作空间（",
        save_res$file_name,
        "），但自动复制到剪贴板失败。请在提交码文本框中按 Ctrl+A，再按 Ctrl+C。"
      ),
      type = "warning",
      duration = 9
    )
    return()
  }

  showNotification(
    paste0(
      "自动复制和 txt 文件保存均未成功。复制失败原因：",
      if (!is.null(res$message) && nzchar(res$message)) {
        res$message
      } else {
        "当前窗口禁止自动访问剪贴板。"
      },
      "；文件保存失败原因：",
      if (!is.null(save_res$message) && nzchar(save_res$message)) {
        save_res$message
      } else {
        "未知原因。"
      }
    ),
    type = "warning",
    duration = 12
  )
})
```

```{r exam-cleanup, context="server", include=FALSE}
.exam_rmd_path <- normalizePath(
  file.path(getwd(), "exam.Rmd"),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = FALSE
)

session$onSessionEnded(function() {
  try(
    rmarkdown::shiny_prerendered_clean(.exam_rmd_path),
    silent = TRUE
  )
})
```
