```{r exam-js, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
cat(
'<script>
var rmedlearnCodeLabels = [];
var rmedlearnFillIds = [];
var rmedlearnEnabledFillIds = [];
var rmedlearnLastSnapshot = "";
var rmedlearnPendingRestore = null;
var rmedlearnRestoreHydrated = true;

function rmedlearnAddRunHints() {
  var buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".btn-tutorial-run");

  for (var i = 0; i < buttons.length; i++) {
    var btn = buttons[i];

    if (btn.parentElement && btn.parentElement.classList.contains("rmedlearn-run-control")) {
      continue;
    }

    var parent = btn.parentNode;
    if (!parent) continue;

    var wrap = document.createElement("span");
    wrap.className = "rmedlearn-run-control";
    parent.insertBefore(wrap, btn);
    wrap.appendChild(btn);

    var hint = document.createElement("span");
    hint.className = "rmedlearn-run-hint";
    hint.textContent = "点此键运行代码框，切勿选中部分代码。";
    wrap.appendChild(hint);
  }
}

function rmedlearnTranslateButtons() {
  var map = {
    "Run Code": "运行代码",
    "Next Topic": "下一专题",
    "Previous Topic": "上一专题",
    "Hint": "提示",
    "Solution": "参考"
  };

  var nodes = document.querySelectorAll("button, a.btn");

  for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
    var text = nodes[i].textContent.trim();

    if (map[text]) {
      nodes[i].textContent = map[text];
    }
  }

  rmedlearnAddRunHints();
}

function rmedlearnTranslateFeedback(root) {
  if (!root) {
    return;
  }

  var nodes = root.querySelectorAll(
    ".alert, .tutorial-exercise-output, .tutorial-exercise-output-frame"
  );

  var replacements = [
    [
      "An internal error occurred while setting up the exercise. Please try again or contact the tutorial author.",
      "练习初始化时发生内部错误。请重试；如果仍有问题，请联系教师。"
    ],
    [
      "An internal error occurred while running the exercise. Please try again or contact the tutorial author.",
      "运行代码时发生内部错误。请重试；如果仍有问题，请联系教师。"
    ],
    [
      "An internal error occurred while checking the exercise. Please try again or contact the tutorial author.",
      "检查代码时发生内部错误。请重试；如果仍有问题，请联系教师。"
    ]
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
    var walker = document.createTreeWalker(
      nodes[i],
      NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,
      null
    );

    var textNode;

    while ((textNode = walker.nextNode())) {
      var value = textNode.nodeValue;

      for (var j = 0; j < replacements.length; j++) {
        value = value.split(replacements[j][0]).join(replacements[j][1]);
      }

      value = value.split("Warning message:").join("警告：");
      value = value.split("Warning:").join("警告：");
      value = value.split("Error:").join("错误：");
      value = value.split("could not find function").join("找不到函数");
      value = value.split("not found").join("未找到");
      value = value.split("unexpected symbol").join("出现无法解析的符号");
      value = value.split("unexpected input").join("出现无法解析的输入");
      value = value.split("unexpected end of input").join("代码意外结束，请检查括号、引号或表达式是否完整");

      textNode.nodeValue = value;
    }
  }
}

function rmedlearnExerciseEditor(label) {
  if (
    !window.tutorial ||
    typeof window.tutorial.$exerciseEditor !== "function" ||
    !window.ace
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    var jqEditor = window.tutorial.$exerciseEditor(label);

    if (
      !jqEditor ||
      jqEditor.length === 0 ||
      !jqEditor.attr("id")
    ) {
      return null;
    }

    return window.ace.edit(
      jqEditor.attr("id")
    );
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}

function rmedlearnCollectSnapshot(force) {
  if (
    !document.body ||
    !document.body.classList.contains("exam-ready") ||
    !window.Shiny
  ) {
    return;
  }

  var sid = document.getElementById("student_id");

  if (!sid || !sid.value) {
    return;
  }

  var codes = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < rmedlearnCodeLabels.length; i++) {
    var label = rmedlearnCodeLabels[i];
    var editor = rmedlearnExerciseEditor(label);

    if (editor) {
      try {
        codes[label] = editor.getSession().getValue();
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  var fills = {};

  // 只读取当前页面中实际存在的填空输入框。
  // 没有渲染的题目不会被写成空值，因此不会覆盖已有恢复记录。
  if (rmedlearnRestoreHydrated) {
    for (var j = 0; j < rmedlearnFillIds.length; j++) {
      var fillId = rmedlearnFillIds[j];
      var fillEl = document.getElementById(fillId);

      if (fillEl) {
        fills[fillId] = String(
          fillEl.value == null ? "" : fillEl.value
        );
      }
    }
  }

  // 恢复后的答题记录允许继续修改：每次快照都同步更新浏览器中的恢复缓存。
  // 这样切换专题后再次写回时，使用的是学生刚刚修改后的内容，而不是退出前的旧内容。
  if (rmedlearnPendingRestore) {
    if (!rmedlearnPendingRestore.codes) {
      rmedlearnPendingRestore.codes = {};
    }

    Object.keys(codes).forEach(function(label) {
      rmedlearnPendingRestore.codes[label] = codes[label];
    });

    if (!rmedlearnPendingRestore.fills) {
      rmedlearnPendingRestore.fills = {};
    }

    Object.keys(fills).forEach(function(id) {
      rmedlearnPendingRestore.fills[id] = fills[id];
    });
  }

  var comparable = JSON.stringify({
    student_id: String(sid.value).trim(),
    codes: codes,
    fills: fills,
    location_hash: window.location.hash || ""
  });

  if (!force && comparable === rmedlearnLastSnapshot) {
    return;
  }

  rmedlearnLastSnapshot = comparable;

  Shiny.setInputValue(
    "recovery_snapshot",
    {
      student_id: String(sid.value).trim(),
      codes: codes,
      fills: fills,
      location_hash: window.location.hash || "",
      nonce: Date.now()
    },
    {priority: "event"}
  );
}

function rmedlearnSetCodeOnly(label, code) {
  if (
    !window.tutorial ||
    typeof window.tutorial.$exerciseEditor !== "function" ||
    !window.ace
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  try {
    var jqEditor = window.tutorial.$exerciseEditor(label);

    if (
      !jqEditor ||
      jqEditor.length === 0 ||
      !jqEditor.attr("id")
    ) {
      return false;
    }

    var editor = window.ace.edit(
      jqEditor.attr("id")
    );

    var text = String(
      code == null ? "" : code
    );

    if (
      editor.getSession().getValue() !== text
    ) {
      editor.getSession().setValue(text);
      editor.clearSelection();
    }

    return true;
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }
}

function rmedlearnApplyRestore(payload) {
  if (!payload) {
    return false;
  }

  var codes = payload.codes || {};
  var labels = Object.keys(codes);
  var codeReady = true;

  for (var i = 0; i < labels.length; i++) {
    var label = labels[i];
    var value = String(
      codes[label] == null ? "" : codes[label]
    );

    if (!value.trim()) {
      continue;
    }

    if (
      !rmedlearnSetCodeOnly(
        label,
        value
      )
    ) {
      codeReady = false;
    }
  }

  var fills = payload.fills || {};

  Object.keys(fills).forEach(function(id) {
    var el = document.getElementById(id);

    if (el) {
      var value = String(
        fills[id] == null ? "" : fills[id]
      );

      if (el.value !== value) {
        el.value = value;

        el.dispatchEvent(
          new Event(
            "input",
            {bubbles: true}
          )
        );

        el.dispatchEvent(
          new Event(
            "change",
            {bubbles: true}
          )
        );
      }
    }
  });

  return codeReady;
}


function rmedlearnApplyFillAccess() {
  for (var i = 0; i < rmedlearnFillIds.length; i++) {
    var id = rmedlearnFillIds[i];
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) continue;
    el.disabled = false;
    el.removeAttribute("title");
  }
}

Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("examFillAccess", function(msg) {
  var ids = (msg && Array.isArray(msg.ids)) ? msg.ids : [];
  var enabled = !!(msg && msg.enabled);
  ids.forEach(function(id) {
    var idx = rmedlearnEnabledFillIds.indexOf(id);
    if (enabled && idx < 0) rmedlearnEnabledFillIds.push(id);
    if (!enabled && idx >= 0) rmedlearnEnabledFillIds.splice(idx, 1);
  });
  setTimeout(rmedlearnApplyFillAccess, 50);
  setTimeout(rmedlearnApplyFillAccess, 400);
});


Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("examEntryState", function(msg) {
  var startBtn = document.getElementById("start_new_exam");
  var restoreBtn = document.getElementById("restore_exam");
  var sid = document.getElementById("student_id");
  var cls = document.getElementById("class_name");
  var sname = document.getElementById("student_name");
  var mode = (msg && msg.mode) ? msg.mode : "new";

  if (mode === "recovery") {
    if (cls && msg.class_name != null) cls.value = String(msg.class_name);
    if (sid && msg.student_id != null) sid.value = String(msg.student_id);
    if (sname && msg.student_name != null) sname.value = String(msg.student_name);

    if (startBtn) {
      startBtn.disabled = true;
      startBtn.setAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
    }
    if (restoreBtn) {
      restoreBtn.disabled = false;
      restoreBtn.removeAttribute("aria-disabled");
    }

    if (sid) sid.disabled = true;
    if (cls) cls.disabled = true;
    if (sname) sname.disabled = true;
  } else {
    if (startBtn) {
      startBtn.disabled = false;
      startBtn.removeAttribute("aria-disabled");
    }
    if (restoreBtn) {
      restoreBtn.disabled = true;
      restoreBtn.setAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
    }

    if (sid) sid.disabled = false;
    if (cls) cls.disabled = false;
    if (sname) sname.disabled = false;
  }
});

Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("examReady", function(msg) {
  if (document.body) {
    document.body.classList.add("exam-ready");
  setTimeout(rmedlearnApplyFillAccess, 200);
  setTimeout(rmedlearnApplyFillAccess, 800);
  }

  if (msg && Array.isArray(msg.code_labels)) {
    rmedlearnCodeLabels = msg.code_labels;
  }

  if (msg && Array.isArray(msg.fill_ids)) {
    rmedlearnFillIds = msg.fill_ids;
  }
  rmedlearnEnabledFillIds = (msg && Array.isArray(msg.enabled_fill_ids)) ? msg.enabled_fill_ids.slice() : [];

  // 恢复模式先暂停填空快照，等 saved$fills 真正写回页面后再开启。
  // 防止页面初始空输入框覆盖本地已有答案。
  rmedlearnRestoreHydrated = !(
    msg &&
    msg.mode === "restored"
  );

  var content = document.getElementById("exam-content");

  if (content) {
    content.style.display = "block";
  }

  var startBtn = document.getElementById("start_new_exam");
  var restoreBtn = document.getElementById("restore_exam");
  var sid = document.getElementById("student_id");
  var cls = document.getElementById("class_name");
  var sname = document.getElementById("student_name");

  if (startBtn) {
    startBtn.disabled = true;
  }

  if (restoreBtn) {
    restoreBtn.disabled = true;
  }

  if (sid) sid.disabled = true;
  if (cls) cls.disabled = true;
  if (sname) sname.disabled = true;

  setTimeout(
    rmedlearnTranslateButtons,
    100
  );
});

Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("restoreExamState", function(msg) {
  rmedlearnPendingRestore = msg || {};

  // 先恢复当前已渲染的填空框，再允许后续 5 秒快照写回。
  var initialFills = rmedlearnPendingRestore.fills || {};

  Object.keys(initialFills).forEach(function(id) {
    var el = document.getElementById(id);

    if (el) {
      var value = String(
        initialFills[id] == null ? "" : initialFills[id]
      );

      if (el.value !== value) {
        el.value = value;

        el.dispatchEvent(
          new Event(
            "input",
            {bubbles: true}
          )
        );

        el.dispatchEvent(
          new Event(
            "change",
            {bubbles: true}
          )
        );
      }
    }
  });

  rmedlearnRestoreHydrated = true;

  if (
    rmedlearnPendingRestore.location_hash &&
    window.location.hash !== rmedlearnPendingRestore.location_hash
  ) {
    window.location.hash =
      rmedlearnPendingRestore.location_hash;
  }

  var attempts = 0;

  function tryRestore() {
    attempts += 1;

    if (
      rmedlearnApplyRestore(
        rmedlearnPendingRestore
      )
    ) {
      rmedlearnCollectSnapshot(true);
      return;
    }

    if (attempts < 8) {
      setTimeout(
        tryRestore,
        300
      );
    }
  }

  setTimeout(
    tryRestore,
    250
  );
});

Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("showSubmission", function(msg) {
  var panel = document.getElementById("submission-panel");

  if (panel) {
    panel.style.display = "block";
    panel.scrollIntoView({
      behavior: "smooth"
    });
  }
});

Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("copyText", async function(msg) {
  var text = (
    msg &&
    typeof msg.text === "string"
  ) ? msg.text : "";

  function notify(ok, message) {
    Shiny.setInputValue(
      "submission_copy_result",
      {
        ok: ok,
        message: message || "",
        nonce: Date.now()
      },
      {priority: "event"}
    );
  }

  function fallbackCopy() {
    try {
      var box = document.getElementById(
        "submission_code_display"
      );

      if (box) {
        box.focus();
        box.select();

        if (
          typeof box.setSelectionRange === "function"
        ) {
          box.setSelectionRange(
            0,
            box.value.length
          );
        }

        var ok = document.execCommand("copy");

        if (ok) {
          return true;
        }
      }

      var temp = document.createElement(
        "textarea"
      );

      temp.value = text;
      temp.setAttribute(
        "readonly",
        ""
      );

      temp.style.position = "fixed";
      temp.style.left = "-9999px";
      temp.style.top = "0";

      document.body.appendChild(temp);
      temp.focus();
      temp.select();

      var ok2 = document.execCommand("copy");

      document.body.removeChild(temp);

      return ok2;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  if (!text) {
    notify(
      false,
      "提交码为空。"
    );
    return;
  }

  try {
    if (
      navigator.clipboard &&
      typeof navigator.clipboard.writeText === "function"
    ) {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      notify(true, "");
      return;
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  if (fallbackCopy()) {
    notify(true, "");
  } else {
    notify(
      false,
      "当前窗口禁止自动访问剪贴板，请使用 Ctrl+A / Ctrl+C 手动复制。"
    );
  }
});

/* 只有学生实际点击代码框后才显示 Ace 光标，避免空白代码框出现误导性的“假光标”。 */
document.addEventListener(
  "mousedown",
  function(evt) {
    var editors = document.querySelectorAll(
      ".ace_editor.rmedlearn-user-focused"
    );

    for (var i = 0; i < editors.length; i++) {
      editors[i].classList.remove(
        "rmedlearn-user-focused"
      );
    }

    var editor = evt.target.closest
      ? evt.target.closest(".ace_editor")
      : null;

    if (editor) {
      editor.classList.add(
        "rmedlearn-user-focused"
      );
    }
  },
  true
);

document.addEventListener(
  "focusout",
  function(evt) {
    var editor = evt.target.closest
      ? evt.target.closest(".ace_editor")
      : null;

    if (editor) {
      setTimeout(function() {
        if (!editor.contains(document.activeElement)) {
          editor.classList.remove(
            "rmedlearn-user-focused"
          );
        }
      }, 0);
    }
  },
  true
);

document.addEventListener(
  "click",
  function(evt) {
    var runBtn = evt.target.closest
      ? evt.target.closest(".btn-tutorial-run")
      : null;

    if (runBtn) {
      var exercise = runBtn.closest(
        ".tutorial-exercise"
      );

      [250, 800, 1600, 3000].forEach(function(delay) {
        setTimeout(
          function() {
            rmedlearnTranslateFeedback(exercise);
            rmedlearnTranslateButtons();
          },
          delay
        );
      });
    }

    var topic = evt.target.closest
      ? evt.target.closest(".topicsList .topic")
      : null;

    var navControl = evt.target.closest
      ? evt.target.closest("button, a")
      : null;

    var navText = navControl
      ? navControl.textContent.trim()
      : "";

    var isTopicNavigation = !!topic ||
      navText === "Next Topic" ||
      navText === "Previous Topic" ||
      navText === "下一专题" ||
      navText === "上一专题";

    if (isTopicNavigation) {
      // click 监听使用捕获阶段，因此这里会在 learnr 真正切换专题前
      // 先保存当前页面刚刚修改过的代码和填空。
      rmedlearnCollectSnapshot(true);

      setTimeout(
        function() {
          if (rmedlearnPendingRestore) {
            rmedlearnApplyRestore(
              rmedlearnPendingRestore
            );
          }

          rmedlearnTranslateButtons();
          rmedlearnApplyFillAccess();
        },
        300
      );
    }
  },
  true
);

setTimeout(
  rmedlearnTranslateButtons,
  500
);

setInterval(
  function() {
    rmedlearnCollectSnapshot(false);
  },
  5000
);

window.addEventListener(
  "beforeunload",
  function() {
    rmedlearnCollectSnapshot(true);
  }
);
</script>'
)
```

## 考试规则与结果填写规范

```{r exam-code-rule, echo=FALSE}
uiOutput("exam_code_rule")
```

<div class="exam-process">

<div class="exam-process-title">考试规则</div>

<div class="exam-process-step"><div class="exam-process-index">1</div><div class="exam-process-content"><strong>同题不同数据。</strong><br>所有学生题目相同，但系统激活时随机分配 X1–X10 中的一套数据。x1.csv–x10.csv 已放在当前考试文件夹中，请按第一页显示的数据编号直接读取对应的 <code>xN.csv</code>。</div></div>
<div class="exam-process-step"><div class="exam-process-index">2</div><div class="exam-process-content"><strong>个人信息必须准确。</strong><br>班级、学号、姓名会写入最终考试记录；请在激活前认真核对。</div></div>
<div class="exam-process-step"><div class="exam-process-index">3</div><div class="exam-process-content"><strong>RStudio 与考试页同步操作。</strong><br>每一步先在本地 R/RStudio 中编写并运行代码，确认能够运行后，再复制到考试页对应代码框并点击“运行代码”。后续题目运行时会依赖前面代码；填空框可直接填写。</div></div>
<div class="exam-process-step"><div class="exam-process-index">4</div><div class="exam-process-content"><strong>结果填写格式。</strong><br>连续数值保留 2 位小数；P 值保留 3 位，小于 0.001 时填写 <code>0.000</code>；比例填写 0–1 之间原始比例，不填写百分号；计数填整数。</div></div>
<div class="exam-process-step"><div class="exam-process-index">5</div><div class="exam-process-content"><strong>激活与提交限制。</strong><br>首次激活后，本机将在 2 小时内锁定本次考试的班级、学号、姓名和随机数据编号；再次打开时不能重新激活，只能使用“恢复上次答题”。提交成功后 2 小时内不能再次生成新的提交码。</div></div>
<div class="exam-process-step"><div class="exam-process-index">6</div><div class="exam-process-content"><strong>允许空题提交。</strong><br>不会做的题可以留空，但没有运行代码、代码运行未通过、填空为空或填空不是数值时，系统会在最终提交前提醒；对应项目按错误处理。</div></div>
<div class="exam-process-step"><div class="exam-process-index">7</div><div class="exam-process-content"><strong>提交前通知监考老师。</strong><br>全部作答完成后，请先提醒监考老师。最终提交窗口中需要确认已经获得监考老师允许后才能生成提交码。</div></div>
<div class="exam-process-step"><div class="exam-process-index">8</div><div class="exam-process-content"><strong>复制并保存提交码。</strong><br>提交成功后点击“复制并保存考试提交码”。系统会同时将提交码复制到剪贴板，并在考试工作空间生成“学号_姓名.txt”；请按教师要求上交该文件。</div></div>

</div>

<div class="environment-note">
<strong>重要：</strong>本地 R/RStudio 与考试系统中的 R 环境彼此独立，但两边都读取同一个磁盘考试文件夹。请务必在两边分别使用相同路径的 <code>setwd()</code>；本地 R 中创建的对象不会自动出现在考试系统中。
</div>
